title: Reset your password
body:
# Reset your password

Use self-service reset if you forgot your password or it expired. You need the phone or verification method you registered.

1. Go to the Northbridge password reset page from the sign-in screen and choose "Forgot my password."
2. Enter your work email and complete the verification code sent to your phone or authenticator app.
3. Choose a new password: at least 12 characters, not used before, and not your name.
4. Sign in everywhere again with the new password, including your phone's email app.

IT will never ask for your password. If you no longer have any verification method, ask TierZero to open a ticket.

title: Set up multi-factor authentication (MFA)
body:
# Set up multi-factor authentication (MFA)

Northbridge requires MFA for email, VPN, and all company apps.

1. Install the Microsoft Authenticator app on your phone from the App Store or Google Play.
2. On your computer, sign in to your Northbridge account and open Security info.
3. Choose "Add sign-in method," pick Authenticator app, and scan the QR code with your phone.
4. Approve the test notification on your phone.
5. Add a second method, such as a phone number, in case you lose your phone.

New phone? Add the app on the new phone before you reset the old one. If you already lost access, ask TierZero to open a ticket.

title: Connect to the VPN
body:
# Connect to the VPN

Use the VPN when you work outside the office and need company systems.

1. Install the Northbridge VPN app from the Company Portal (Windows) or Self Service (Mac). Do not download VPN apps from other websites.
2. Open the app and enter the server address vpn.northbridge.example.
3. Sign in with your work email and password.
4. Approve the MFA prompt on your phone.
5. Wait for the status to show Connected before opening company systems.

If it fails, check that your internet works without the VPN first. If you see "authentication failed," reset your password (kb-001-password-reset). If it still fails, ask TierZero to open a ticket.

title: Connect to office Wi-Fi
body:
# Connect to office Wi-Fi

Northbridge has two networks: NB-Staff for company laptops and NB-Guest for visitors and personal devices.

1. Click the Wi-Fi icon on your taskbar (Windows) or menu bar (Mac).
2. Choose NB-Staff on a company laptop. Choose NB-Guest on a personal device and accept the terms page.
3. On NB-Staff, sign in with your work email and password if asked.
4. Wait up to a minute for the connection to finish.

If it says "connected, no internet" or keeps dropping, TierZero can walk you through the Wi-Fi guided fix.

title: Approved AI tools at Northbridge
body:
# Approved AI tools at Northbridge

Only use AI tools that IT has approved, and only with the company account.

1. Approved: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Claude through the company's single sign-on. Sign in with your work email, never a personal account.
2. Do not paste customer data, passwords, financial records, or employee personal information into any AI tool.
3. Check AI output before you share it. AI tools can be wrong.
4. To request a new AI tool, ask TierZero to open a ticket with the tool's name and what you need it for. Security reviews each request.

Using an unapproved AI tool with company data breaks the acceptable use policy.

title: Add an office printer
body:
# Add an office printer

Office printers are named by floor, for example NB-PRINT-3 for the third floor.

1. Connect to NB-Staff Wi-Fi or plug into the office network. Printers do not work over NB-Guest or the VPN.
2. Windows: open Settings, then Bluetooth & devices, then Printers & scanners, and choose Add device. Mac: open System Settings, then Printers & Scanners, and choose Add Printer.
3. Pick the printer for your floor from the list.
4. Print a test page.

If the printer is jammed, out of toner, or shows an error light, ask TierZero to open a ticket with the printer's name.
